QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] New Information
QuestInfo.0: The informant at the Knight Stronghold suddenly made contact. Something might have happened. Better go listen to his report.
QuestInfo.1: The informant discovered where Neinheart, the Empress's tactician, is being held. But why is he being held captive? Go and ask #bChief Alex#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the info on Neinheart to Chief Alex.

0.msg: Shh, just listen. I investigated your info from last time. Can you get it to the chief without drawing attention?

1.msg: I found out where #bNeinheart#k, the Empress's tactician, is. He's locked up in a Secret Grove inside the stronghold. I don't know why he's locked up, but I think it's worth investigating.

3.msg: Yeah. Talk to the chief about what to do.

0.msg: That's all I know right now. You can get to the #bSecret Grove#k by going through #bKnight District 4#k.

no.0: We'll only get one chance. Let me know when you're ready to do this right.

1.0: You have news? Let's hear it.

yes.0: So, Neinheart has been located and what's more, he's been imprisoned...

npc.0: Why are you wandering here when I told you to go tell the chief? He's in the #bHenesys Ruins#k.
